mapper.sql: id, name, prompt, schedule_type, schedule_expr, enabled, (lock_until IS NOT NULL AND lock_until > NOW()) AS running, next_run_at, last_status, last_error
mapper.update: UPDATE scheduled_agent_task SET name = #{name}, prompt = #{prompt}, schedule_type = #{scheduleType}, schedule_expr = #{scheduleExpr}, enabled = #{enabled}, next_run_at = #{nextRunAt}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND (lock_until IS NULL OR lock_until < NOW())
UPDATE scheduled_agent_task SET enabled = #{enabled}, next_run_at = #{nextRunAt}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM scheduled_agent_task WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM scheduled_agent_task ORDER BY id DESC
